clusters.title: Improve Tabby completions and IDE integration
clusters.summary: Users want faster code completion experiences through precomputed branch suggestions, accurate documentation about recommended models, and reliable connectivity between their IDE and tabby-agent. These improvements would enhance overall productivity by reducing wait times, providing clearer guidance, and fixing integration issues.
clusters.representative_need: Fix Eclipse plugin connection to tabby-agent
sample_titles: Fix Eclipse plugin connection to tabby-agent
Precompute accept and reject branch suggestions for instant follow-up completions
Update the recommended models documentation with current model recommendations
